description: Every corpus token that is one sign or a combination of signs (a ligature, a vessel sign, a logogram, or a logogram joined to a sign) and has no entry in the lexicon, with its attestations and what is on file for it. The sister of unread_words.json, which holds words of two or more signs. Hand-edited.

statuses.component_read: a combined sign with a component the lexicon reads
statuses.value_on_file: sign_values.json or a translation gives it a value; it has no lexicon entry

kinds.logogram: a logogram named by its Latin code
kinds.compound: a logogram or sign joined to others by a hyphen

excluded.None: a placeholder in the corpus record, not a sign
excluded.double mina: a metrological notation, spelled out in the corpus
excluded.𐁁: a Linear B glyph in the corpus record

Alone on 12 Khania roundels in the corpus (KH Wc 2036–2045, 2095, 2111). Inside a word at Haghia Triada: RA-*164-TI (HT 17, HT 19). Nosch and Weilhartner take it as a syllabogram at Haghia Triada and a logogram at Khania, possibly for textiles, because a similar sign is a textile logogram in Linear B, *164, known only at Knossos (2026). No reading.
